'''2014 Philadelphia Premiere Brad Eier DS Hunt Down and Destroy the Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brad Eier]] at [[2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Brad Eier]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 Philadelphia Premiere Event]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down and Destroy the Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out of the Universe]]
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Prepared Defenses]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-philadelphia-premiere-event-brad-eier-ds-hdadtj/ PC list]
